name: split-preview-editor
title: Split Preview Editor
description: Two-column side-by-side interactive playground with code editor on left and live preview on right.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Split Code And Preview: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
